files.README.md:
# doctrine-mysql-conversions-mapper

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities mapped with Doctrine ORM 3, repositories and services, in PHP 8.4. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mysql.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (classes); updates take a Patch per field: absent, or a value that may be null.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/Database.php             the EntityManager of DATABASE_URL, with the mapping of the entities
src/UnitOfWork.php           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/Entities/                one entity per table
src/Repositories/            the repositories of each table
src/Services/                one service per table
tests/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json           what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
composer install
TEST_DATABASE_URL="mysql://app:app@localhost:3306/app" vendor/bin/phpunit   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A page of a list: the rows from an offset, and how many there are in all.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Page
{
    /** @param list<T> $items */
    public function __construct(public array $items, public int $total, public int $offset, public int $limit)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The same page with every row turned into something else.
     *
     * @template R
     * @param callable(T): R $mapper
     * @return Page<R>
     */
    public function map(callable $mapper): self
    {
        return new self(array_map($mapper, $this->items), $this->total, $this->offset, $this->limit);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A field of an update: absent (it keeps its value), or present with a value, which may be null.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Patch
{
    /** An absent field; use Patch::of() for one with a value. */
    public function __construct(public bool $isPresent = false, public mixed $value = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The field keeps its value.
     *
     * @return Patch<mixed>
     */
    public static function absent(): self
    {
        return new self();
    }

    /**
     * The field takes this value, which may be null.
     *
     * @template V
     * @param V $value
     * @return Patch<V>
     */
    public static function of(mixed $value): self
    {
        return new self(true, $value);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Conversions;

use App\ApplicationModels\CustomerForm;
use App\ApplicationModels\CustomerState;
use App\Dtos\CustomerCreate;
use App\Dtos\CustomerRead;

/** Conversions between the application models and the "customers" table: what the service takes and returns. */
final class CustomerConversions
{
    /** A CustomerForm as the customers table takes it. */
    public static function customerFormToCustomerCreate(CustomerForm $model): CustomerCreate
    {
        return new CustomerCreate(
            email: $model->email,
            fullName: implode(' ', [$model->firstName, $model->lastName]),
            status: self::pair(['ACTIVE' => 'active', 'BLOCKED' => 'blocked'], match ($model->status) { CustomerState::ACTIVE => 'ACTIVE', CustomerState::BLOCKED => 'BLOCKED' }, null),
            createdAt: new \DateTimeImmutable('@' . $model->signedUp),
            balanceCents: (int) round(((float) $model->balance * 100)),
            // TODO: nickname: the matching waits for review (nickname)
            // TODO: country: no field of the model gives it
        );
    }

    /** A row of the customers table as a CustomerForm. */
    public static function customerReadToCustomerForm(CustomerRead $row): CustomerForm
    {
        $model = new CustomerForm();
        $model->email = $row->email;
        // TODO: firstName: Mapper's relation only goes the other way (firstName, lastName)
        // TODO: lastName: Mapper's relation only goes the other way (firstName, lastName)
        $model->status = match (self::pair(['active' => 'ACTIVE', 'blocked' => 'BLOCKED'], $row->status, null)) { 'ACTIVE' => CustomerState::ACTIVE, 'BLOCKED' => CustomerState::BLOCKED, default => throw new \ValueError('No CustomerState for this value') };
        $model->signedUp = $row->createdAt->getTimestamp();
        $model->balance = (string) ((float) $row->balanceCents / 100);
        // TODO: nickname: the matching waits for review (nickname)
        return $model;
    }

    /**
     * The value an enum pair gives, or the fallback; a value without a pair is an error.
     *
     * @param array<string, string> $pairs
     */
    private static function pair(array $pairs, string $value, ?string $fallback): string
    {
        return $pairs[$value] ?? $fallback ?? throw new \ValueError("No pair for {$value}");
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use App\Types\PreciseDateTimeType;
use App\Types\PreciseDateTimeTzType;
use Doctrine\DBAL\DriverManager;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Tools\DsnParser;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Types\Type;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManager;
use Doctrine\ORM\ORMSetup;

/** The database DATABASE_URL names, through Doctrine. It never migrates: the database already exists. */
final class Database
{
    public const DEFAULT_URL = 'mysql://app:app@localhost:3306/app';

    /** The URL of DATABASE_URL, or the default one. */
    public static function url(): string
    {
        $url = getenv('DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : self::DEFAULT_URL;
    }

    /** An EntityManager over the database at $url (DATABASE_URL when null), with the mapping of the entities. */
    public static function open(?string $url = null): EntityManager
    {
        // The timestamps of the entities keep their fractions of a second
        if (!Type::hasType(PreciseDateTimeType::NAME)) {
            Type::addType(PreciseDateTimeType::NAME, PreciseDateTimeType::class);
        }
        if (!Type::hasType(PreciseDateTimeTzType::NAME)) {
            Type::addType(PreciseDateTimeTzType::NAME, PreciseDateTimeTzType::class);
        }
        // The mapping is read from the attributes of the classes under src/
        $config = ORMSetup::createAttributeMetadataConfiguration([__DIR__], true);
        $config->enableNativeLazyObjects(true);
        $parser = new DsnParser(['postgresql' => 'pdo_pgsql', 'postgres' => 'pdo_pgsql', 'mysql' => 'pdo_mysql', 'mariadb' => 'pdo_mysql', 'sqlite' => 'pdo_sqlite']);
        $connection = DriverManager::getConnection($parser->parse($url ?? self::url()), $config);
        return new EntityManager($connection, $config);
    }
}

namespace App\Entities;

use Doctrine\ORM\Mapping as ORM;

/**
 * A row of the "customers" table.
 *
 * CHECK (status IN ('active', 'blocked')): the service checks what it understands of it.

#[ORM\Entity]

class Customer
{
    #[ORM\Id]

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'full_name', type: 'string', length: 120)]
    public ?string $fullName = null;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'status', type: 'string', length: 10)]

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'created_at', type: 'precise_datetime')]

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'balance_cents', type: 'integer')]
    public ?int $balanceCents = null;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'nickname', type: 'string', length: 40, nullable: true)]

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'country', type: 'string', length: 2, options: ['fixed' => true])]

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Entities\Customer;

/** Where customers rows are kept. Services depend only on this interface. */
interface CustomerRepository
{
    /** The row with this primary key, or null. */
    public function findById(int $id): ?Customer;

    /**
     * At most $limit rows from $offset, by primary key, and how many there are.
     *
     * @return Page<Customer>
     */
    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page;

    /** The row with this email, or null. */
    public function findByEmail(string $email): ?Customer;

    /** Stores a new row; the values the database fills are read back. */
    public function insert(Customer $entity): Customer;

    /** Stores the changes made to a row read from this repository. */
    public function update(Customer $entity): Customer;

    /** Removes a row read from this repository. */
    public function delete(Customer $entity): void;
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Entities\Customer;

/** Keeps customers rows in memory, for tests and for trying the services without a database. */
final class MemoryCustomerRepository implements CustomerRepository
{
    /** @var array<string, Customer> */
    private array $rows = [];

    private int $nextId = 1;

    /**
     * The key of a row, as a list of its key values.
     *
     * @return list<mixed>
     */
    private static function keyOf(Customer $row): array
    {
        return [$row->id];
    }

    private static function keyText(Customer $row): string
    {
        return serialize(array_map(fn (mixed $value) => $value instanceof \DateTimeInterface ? $value->format('Y-m-d H:i:s.u P') : $value, self::keyOf($row)));
    }

    /**
     * The rows reads can see, by primary key.
     *
     * @return list<Customer>
     */
    private function visible(): array
    {
        $rows = array_values(array_filter($this->rows, fn (Customer $row) => true));
        usort($rows, fn (Customer $a, Customer $b) => self::keyOf($a) <=> self::keyOf($b));
        return $rows;
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?Customer
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->id == $id) {
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $rows = $this->visible();
        return new Page(array_slice($rows, $offset, $limit), count($rows), $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function findByEmail(string $email): ?Customer
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->email == $email) {
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function insert(Customer $entity): Customer
    {
        if ($entity->id === null) {
            $entity->id = $this->nextId++;
        }
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(Customer $entity): Customer
    {
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(Customer $entity): void
    {
        unset($this->rows[self::keyText($entity)]);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Entities\Customer;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Exception\ConstraintViolationException;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;

/** Keeps customers rows in the database, through Doctrine's EntityManager; every write is flushed at once. A write joins the transaction already open, or is committed at once. */
final class SqlCustomerRepository implements CustomerRepository
{
    public function __construct(private readonly EntityManagerInterface $em)
    {
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?Customer
    {
        return $this->em->createQueryBuilder()
            ->select('e')
            ->from(Customer::class, 'e')
            ->where('e.id = :p0')
            ->setParameter('p0', $id)
            ->getQuery()
            ->getOneOrNullResult();
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $query = $this->em->createQueryBuilder()
            ->select('e')
            ->from(Customer::class, 'e');
        $total = (int) (clone $query)->select('COUNT(e.id)')->getQuery()->getSingleScalarResult();
        $items = $query
            ->orderBy('e.id')
            ->setFirstResult($offset)
            ->setMaxResults($limit)
            ->getQuery()
            ->getResult();
        return new Page($items, $total, $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function findByEmail(string $email): ?Customer
    {
        return $this->em->createQueryBuilder()
            ->select('e')
            ->from(Customer::class, 'e')
            ->where('e.email = :p0')
            ->setParameter('p0', $email)
            ->getQuery()
            ->getOneOrNullResult();
    }

    public function insert(Customer $entity): Customer
    {
        $this->em->persist($entity);
        $this->flush();
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(Customer $entity): Customer
    {
        $this->flush();
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(Customer $entity): void
    {
        $this->em->remove($entity);
        $this->flush();
    }

    /**
     * Stores the pending changes; a database refusal (a unique value, a row still pointed to) becomes a ConflictException.
     * Doctrine closes the EntityManager when the database refuses a change: open another one to go on.
     */
    private function flush(): void
    {
        try {
            $this->em->flush();
        } catch (ConstraintViolationException $error) {
            throw new ConflictException('Customer', 'the database refused the change: ' . $error->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Dtos\CustomerCreate;
use App\Dtos\CustomerRead;
use App\Dtos\CustomerUpdate;
use App\Entities\Customer;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on customers. Each write runs in its own transaction. */
final class CustomerService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "customers" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Customer $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['email'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('email', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('email', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 120) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('email', 'is longer than 120 characters');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['fullName'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('fullName', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('full_name', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 120) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('full_name', 'is longer than 120 characters');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['status'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('status', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('status', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 10) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('status', 'is longer than 10 characters');
            }
            if (!in_array((string) $value, ['active', 'blocked'], true)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('status', 'must be one of: active, blocked');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['createdAt'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('createdAt', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('created_at', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['balanceCents'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('balanceCents', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('balance_cents', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['nickname'] ?? null;
        if ($value !== null) {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 40) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('nickname', 'is longer than 40 characters');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['country'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('country', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('country', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 2) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('country', 'is longer than 2 characters');
            }
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Customer', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Values that must be unique are not taken by another row.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function checkUnique(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Customer $current): void
    {
        $email = array_key_exists('email', $values) ? $values['email'] : $current?->email;
        if ($email !== null) {
            $other = $uow->customers->findByEmail($email);
            if ($other !== null && ($current === null || $other->id != $current->id)) {
                throw new ConflictException('Customer', 'email is already taken', ['email']);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Customer $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
        self::checkUnique($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Customer $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('email', $values)) {
            $entity->email = $values['email'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('fullName', $values)) {
            $entity->fullName = $values['fullName'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('status', $values)) {
            $entity->status = $values['status'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('createdAt', $values)) {
            $entity->createdAt = $values['createdAt'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('balanceCents', $values)) {
            $entity->balanceCents = $values['balanceCents'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('nickname', $values)) {
            $entity->nickname = $values['nickname'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('country', $values)) {
            $entity->country = $values['country'];
        }
    }

    /** The Customer with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, int $id): Customer
    {
        return $uow->customers->findById($id) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Customer', $id);
    }

    /** The Customer as services return it. */
    private static function read(Customer $entity): CustomerRead
    {
        return new CustomerRead(
            id: $entity->id,
            email: $entity->email,
            fullName: $entity->fullName,
            status: $entity->status,
            createdAt: $entity->createdAt,
            balanceCents: $entity->balanceCents,
            nickname: $entity->nickname,
            country: $entity->country,
        );
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(CustomerUpdate $changes): array
    {
        $values = [];
        if ($changes->email->isPresent) {
            $values['email'] = $changes->email->value;
        }
        if ($changes->fullName->isPresent) {
            $values['fullName'] = $changes->fullName->value;
        }
        if ($changes->status->isPresent) {
            $values['status'] = $changes->status->value;
        }
        if ($changes->createdAt->isPresent) {
            $values['createdAt'] = $changes->createdAt->value;
        }
        if ($changes->balanceCents->isPresent) {
            $values['balanceCents'] = $changes->balanceCents->value;
        }
        if ($changes->nickname->isPresent) {
            $values['nickname'] = $changes->nickname->value;
        }
        if ($changes->country->isPresent) {
            $values['country'] = $changes->country->value;
        }
        return $values;
    }

    /** Stores a new Customer after checking it. */
    public function createCustomer(CustomerCreate $data): CustomerRead
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'email' => $data->email,
            'fullName' => $data->fullName,
            'status' => $data->status,
            'createdAt' => $data->createdAt,
            'balanceCents' => $data->balanceCents,
            'nickname' => $data->nickname,
            'country' => $data->country,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values): CustomerRead {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            $entity = new Customer();
            self::apply($entity, $values);
            return self::read($uow->customers->insert($entity));
        });
    }

    /** The Customer with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getCustomer(int $id): CustomerRead
    {
        return self::read(self::find($this->uow, $id));
    }

    /**
     * A page of customers, by primary key.
     *
     * @return Page<CustomerRead>
     */
    public function listCustomers(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        return $this->uow->customers->list($offset, $limit)->map(self::read(...));
    }

    /** Changes the given values of a Customer. */
    public function updateCustomer(int $id, CustomerUpdate $changes): CustomerRead
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): CustomerRead {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return self::read($uow->customers->update($current));
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a Customer. */
    public function deleteCustomer(int $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            $uow->customers->delete($current);
        });
    }

    /** The Customer with this email, or null. */
    public function findCustomerByEmail(string $email): ?CustomerRead
    {
        $entity = $this->uow->customers->findByEmail($email);
        return $entity === null ? null : self::read($entity);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use App\Repositories\CustomerRepository;
use App\Repositories\SqlCustomerRepository;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;

/** The repositories over one EntityManager, and the transaction of its connection. */
final class SqlUnitOfWork implements UnitOfWork
{
    public readonly CustomerRepository $customers;

    public function __construct(public readonly EntityManagerInterface $em)
    {
        $this->customers = new SqlCustomerRepository($em);
    }

    public function transaction(callable $work): mixed
    {
        $connection = $this->em->getConnection();
        // Joins the transaction already open
        if ($connection->isTransactionActive()) {
            return $work($this);
        }
        $connection->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $result = $work($this);
            $this->em->flush();
            $connection->commit();
            return $result;
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            $connection->rollBack();
            $this->em->clear();
            throw $error;
        }
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Types;

use Doctrine\DBAL\Platforms\AbstractPlatform;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Types\DateTimeImmutableType;

/** A timestamp without a time zone, read whatever its fractions of a second and written with microseconds. */
final class PreciseDateTimeType extends DateTimeImmutableType
{
    public const NAME = 'precise_datetime';

    public function convertToPHPValue(mixed $value, AbstractPlatform $platform): ?\DateTimeImmutable
    {
        if ($value === null || $value instanceof \DateTimeImmutable) {
            return $value;
        }
        return new \DateTimeImmutable((string) $value);
    }

    public function convertToDatabaseValue(mixed $value, AbstractPlatform $platform): ?string
    {
        if ($value instanceof \DateTimeInterface) {
            return $value->format('Y-m-d H:i:s.u');
        }
        return parent::convertToDatabaseValue($value, $platform);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use App\Repositories\CustomerRepository;

/** What services depend on: a repository per table and a transaction. Each service operation runs in transaction(): committed when it ends, rolled back when it fails. */
interface UnitOfWork
{
    public CustomerRepository $customers { get; }

    /**
     * Runs work with the repositories of the transaction; commits when it ends, rolls back when it throws.
     *
     * @template T
     * @param callable(UnitOfWork): T $work
     * @return T
     */
    public function transaction(callable $work): mixed;
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\SqlUnitOfWork;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/** The repository of the "customers" table, against the test database. */
final class CustomerRepositoryTest extends TestCase
{
    /** The repositories over the test database, opened empty for every test */
    private SqlUnitOfWork $uow;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->uow = TestDatabase::open();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->uow->em->getConnection()->close();
    }

    public function testIsStoredAndReadBack(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $stored = Factories::addCustomer($uow, 1);
        $uow->em->clear();
        $found = $uow->customers->findById($stored->id);
        self::assertNotNull($found);
        self::assertEquals($stored->id, $found->id);
        self::assertNotNull($uow->customers->findByEmail($stored->email));
    }

    public function testListsRowsByKey(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        Factories::addCustomer($uow, 1);
        Factories::addCustomer($uow, 2);
        $page = $uow->customers->list(0, 1);
        self::assertSame(2, $page->total);
        self::assertCount(1, $page->items);
    }

    public function testStoresTheChanges(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $stored = Factories::addCustomer($uow, 1);
        $stored->fullName = 'changed';
        $uow->customers->update($stored);
        $uow->em->clear();
        self::assertSame('changed', $uow->customers->findById($stored->id)->fullName);
    }

    public function testIsDeleted(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $stored = Factories::addCustomer($uow, 1);
        $key0 = $stored->id;
        $uow->customers->delete($stored);
        self::assertNull($uow->customers->findById($key0));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Common\Patch;
use App\Dtos\CustomerCreate;
use App\Dtos\CustomerUpdate;
use App\Entities\Customer;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\MemoryUnitOfWork;
use App\Services\CustomerService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/** The service of the "customers" table, on the in-memory repositories. */
final class CustomerServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    private MemoryUnitOfWork $uow;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->uow = new MemoryUnitOfWork();
    }

    public function testCreatesAValidRow(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $service = new CustomerService($uow);
        $row = Factories::newCustomer(1);
        $created = $service->createCustomer(self::createOf($row));
        $found = $service->getCustomer($created->id);
        self::assertEquals($created->id, $found->id);
    }

    public function testRefusesAMissingValue(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $service = new CustomerService($uow);
        $row = Factories::newCustomer(1);
        $row->email = null;
        try {
            $service->createCustomer(self::createOf($row));
            self::fail('A Customer without email was taken');
        } catch (ValidationFailedException $error) {
            self::assertSame(['email'], array_map(fn (FieldError $item) => $item->field, $error->errors));
        }
    }

    public function testRefusesARepeatedUniqueValue(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $service = new CustomerService($uow);
        $row = Factories::newCustomer(1);
        $first = $service->createCustomer(self::createOf($row));
        $again = Factories::newCustomer(2);
        $again->email = $first->email;
        $this->expectException(ConflictException::class);
        $service->createCustomer(self::createOf($again));
    }

    public function testKeepsItsOwnUniqueValue(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $service = new CustomerService($uow);
        $row = Factories::newCustomer(1);
        $created = $service->createCustomer(self::createOf($row));
        $updated = $service->updateCustomer($created->id, new CustomerUpdate(email: Patch::of($created->email)));
        self::assertEquals($created->email, $updated->email);
    }

    public function testSaysWhenARowIsMissing(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $service = new CustomerService($uow);
        $this->expectException(NotFoundException::class);
        $service->getCustomer(999999);
    }

    public function testChangesARow(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $service = new CustomerService($uow);
        $row = Factories::newCustomer(1);
        $created = $service->createCustomer(self::createOf($row));
        $updated = $service->updateCustomer($created->id, new CustomerUpdate(fullName: Patch::of('changed')));
        self::assertSame('changed', $updated->fullName);
    }

    public function testDeletesARow(): void
    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $service = new CustomerService($uow);
        $row = Factories::newCustomer(1);
        $created = $service->createCustomer(self::createOf($row));
        $key0 = $created->id;
        $service->deleteCustomer($key0);
        $this->expectException(NotFoundException::class);
        $service->getCustomer($key0);
    }

    /** The create DTO of a row the factories made. */
    private static function createOf(Customer $row): CustomerCreate
    {
        return new CustomerCreate(
            email: $row->email,
            fullName: $row->fullName,
            status: $row->status,
            createdAt: $row->createdAt,
            balanceCents: $row->balanceCents,
            nickname: $row->nickname,
            country: $row->country,
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Entities\Customer;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Rows for the tests: valid values for every column, and the rows they point to. */
final class Factories
{
    /** A valid Customer that is not stored yet; $n makes its unique values differ. */
    public static function newCustomer(int $n): Customer
    {
        $entity = new Customer();
        $entity->email = "email-{$n}";
        $entity->fullName = "fullname-{$n}";
        $entity->status = 'active';
        $entity->createdAt = new \DateTimeImmutable(sprintf('2026-01-%02d 12:00:00', $n % 28 + 1));
        $entity->balanceCents = $n;
        $entity->nickname = "nickname-{$n}";
        $entity->country = str_pad((string) ($n % 100), 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        return $entity;
    }

    /** A stored Customer. */
    public static function addCustomer(UnitOfWork $uow, int $n): Customer
    {
        $entity = self::newCustomer($n);
        return $uow->customers->insert($entity);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Database;
use App\SqlUnitOfWork;
use Doctrine\ORM\Tools\SchemaTool;

/** The test database: the MySQL database TEST_DATABASE_URL names, created empty from the mapping for every test. */
final class TestDatabase
{
    public static function url(): ?string
    {
        $url = getenv('TEST_DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : null;
    }

    /** The repositories over the test database, with every table dropped and created again. */
    public static function open(): SqlUnitOfWork
    {
        // The mapping is written for one kind of database: the tests cannot fall back to SQLite
        $em = Database::open(self::url() ?? throw new \RuntimeException('The database tests need a disposable MySQL database: set TEST_DATABASE_URL (it is emptied)'));
        $connection = $em->getConnection();
        $tool = new SchemaTool($em);
        $tool->dropDatabase();
        $schema = $tool->getSchemaFromMetadata($em->getMetadataFactory()->getAllMetadata());
        foreach ($schema->toSql($connection->getDatabasePlatform()) as $sql) {
            $connection->executeStatement($sql);
        }
        return new SqlUnitOfWork($em);
    }
}
